text:
Emma (Partnerships): Heads-up: joint webinar w/ AstraCloud + VectorCompute at CloudCon. Request: 18-20m live demo + marketplace mention. Who can speak?
Kai (Partnerships): We should do 2 speakers + 1 demo. Proposed: Emma intro, Lina hardware demo, Omar product demo.
Maya (Marketing): We'll need co-brand slide templates, a 1-pager PDF, and a digital coupon for attendees. No physical swag.
Lina (VectorCompute): Confirmed for demo. Bringing a single-node rig. Need network whitelisting and model artifact access.
Omar (Eng): I'll prepare a pre-warmed hosted fallback and a short pre-record in case network flops. Also will share a Docker quickstart snippet.
Emma (Partnerships): Action list: - Maya: assets + QR coupon - Omar: fallback prerecord + Docker quickstart - Lina: demo checklist + kernel build - Kai: finalize run order by Wed EOD PT
DevBot: Rehearsal auto-booked 2026-04-22 14:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
Maya (Marketing): Coupon idea: 30% off first month for marketplace listings. Will produce rotating codes. Need legal ok.
Omar (Eng): Quickstart snippet:
```
 docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 \\
   -e MODEL=https://s3.redwood.test/cloudcon/model.tar.gz \\
   redwood/demo:cloudcon
```
Use in the attendee lab.
Lina (VectorCompute): Logistics: need 2x 10Gb ethernet + power. Booth ops, pls confirm.
Kai (Partnerships): Also add an opt-in telemetry checkbox on the quickstart so Optimize team can collect anonymized latency/cost samples. Keep opt-in only.
Emma (Partnerships): Solid. Folder: https://drive.redwood.com/CloudCon/launchpad 5 drop slides, prerecords, and the one-pager there. Reply if blocked. :thumbsup:
